name: smwmusic-castlevania-iii-dracula-s-curse-lost-in-the-sea-aquarius-remix
title: Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse - Lost In The Sea ~ Aquarius (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Aquarius from Akumajou Densetsu We don't talk about the international release of the game, known as Castlevania III. Given the amount of Castlevania songs I've done, Aquarius was inevitable given the song's popularity. Honestly, I've been meaning to do a song from this game ever since I first started doing arrangements / ports on this site, given this is one of my favorite Castlevania soundtracks.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Minor (Custom Pitch)
